subject.title: fix(imessage): keep fast progress out of chat

question: After the PR is rebased, should the iMessage owner require an inspectable redacted capture of the full bridge-backed turn before accepting this fast-progress suppression change?
rationale: The contributor's copied live output establishes useful signal, but it does not independently demonstrate the absence of the transient chat bubble; the protected channel label requires a human judgment on proof sufficiency.

options.title: Request visible bridge proof
options.body: Require a redacted screenshot, recording, or export that shows the inbound prompt, no fast-mode bubble, and the final assistant reply on the rebased head.

options.title: Accept the written run record
options.body: Treat the current bridge-run narrative and focused tests as sufficient despite the missing inspectable conversation artifact.

recommendation.title: Request visible bridge proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted screenshot, recording, or export that shows the inbound prompt, no fast-mode bubble, and the final assistant reply on the rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline explicitly identifies this person in the iMessage review discussion, though file-history ownership remains low-confidence.
